# ai-shield

> ai-shield is an interactive prompt-injection defence game where players wire layered security checks on a visual node board to protect an LLM agent from injection waves, jailbreaks, secret leaks, and unauthorized tool calls.

Players connect defence nodes between the `Input` source and the final node (`Help Desk` on Easy levels, or `Protected Agent` on Medium, Hard, and Custom). Each wave sends a mix of normal user prompts and prompt-injection attacks through the board and scores the run from 0 to 10,000 points. To win a wave, a board must stop every attack without blocking any legitimate prompt.

## Pages

- [Main Menu & Leaderboard](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/): Difficulty and level selector for the 23-level campaign, and a live leaderboard for each difficulty.
- [Defence Board](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game): Interactive Vue Flow canvas where players place, configure, and wire security checks, run waves, test single messages, and inspect confusion-matrix results.
- [Plans](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/plans): `Free` ($0: 5 wave runs and 20 tests per day) and `Paid` ($5 for 30 days, one payment that does not renew: 300 wave runs and 1,000 tests per day, all campaign levels, and the Custom sandbox).

## Game Levels

The campaign has 23 levels. Levels marked `Paid` need a pass.

### Easy

- [Public Helpdesk](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=easy-1): Stop direct prompt overrides and oversized prompt-stuffing payloads while letting store customer questions through.
- [Hidden in Plain Sight](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=easy-2): Normalize zero-width obfuscation, Base64 strings, and hex smuggling with Text Cleaner before scanning for secret phrases.
- [Train Your First Guard](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=easy-3): Only the ML Filter is available here. Train it from CSV examples and route Safe vs. Unclear prompts without blocking polite questions.
- [Developer Docs Trap](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=easy-4): Legitimate developers ask educational questions mentioning SELECT * and API_KEY setup; filter real credential theft within 4 check nodes. (`Paid`)
- [The Noisy Gateway](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=easy-5): Easy capstone combining oversized stuffing, zero-width smuggling, paraphrased overrides, and benign lookalikes under an 8 ms SLA. (`Paid`)

### Medium

- [HR Handbook Assistant](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=medium-1): Stop base64 tricks and roleplay jailbreaks without blocking staff who ask normal policy questions.
- [Over-Helpful Refund Bot](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=medium-2): Let valid parcel questions use lookup_order while switching off issue_refund when impatient shoppers slip in quick-fix refund requests.
- [Poisoned Inbox](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=medium-3): Summarize legitimate supplier emails while stripping hidden forwarding instructions buried inside quoted email threads. (`Paid`)
- [Lost in Translation](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=medium-4): Word Filter is disabled. Catch Malay, Spanish, and JSON-wrapped overrides semantically without over-spending or blocking clinic bookings. (`Paid`)
- [Confused Dev Copilot](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=medium-5): Let engineers ask harmless debugging questions about .env files and SQL joins while blocking real read_env_secrets and run_sql attacks. (`Paid`)
- [50ms Express Lane](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=medium-6): Route obvious benign FX inquiries past expensive LLM checks to keep the entire wave under a strict $0.005 total cost cap. (`Paid`)
- [IT Helpdesk Triage](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=medium-7): Tickets bait three separate privileged IT actions (reset_mfa, grant_admin, delete_ticket). Route tool policy selectively within 5 check nodes. (`Paid`)
- [Dual-Use Refund Desk](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=medium-8): First Dual-Use tool: issue_store_credit MUST work for verified damaged deliveries, yet MUST be switched off on quick-fix bait and attacks. (`Paid`)
- [Encoded Cargo Courier](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=medium-9): Tracking remarks hide Base64 and URL-encoded tool-rerouting directives. Clean encoded text before Tool Policy decides what to gate. (`Paid`)
- [Dual-Use CRM Boss](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=medium-10): Medium capstone: gate Dual-Use send_customer_email selectively, guard delete_account/export_crm, and stay within 5 check nodes. (`Paid`)

### Hard

- [Warehouse Ops Under Siege](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=hard-1): Defend a gullible warehouse assistant across 6 tools against multi-vector chained injections, Base64 directives, and Pattern C/D tool baits. (`Paid`)
- [No Heavy Weapons](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=hard-2): Banking compliance prohibits LLM review. Stop attacks and tool bait against a gullible banking assistant with lighter checks and Jev. (`Paid`)
- [The Auditor's Minefield](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=hard-3): Word Filter is disabled and legitimate compliance auditors quote attack strings verbatim in audit reports. Avoid false alarms on quoted text. (`Paid`)
- [Polyglot & Stego Smuggler](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=hard-4): SRE telemetry hides URL-encoded JSON, Base64 key-rotation commands, and YAML tool invocations. Clean and block within 5 check nodes. (`Paid`)
- [Dual-Use Finance Desk](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=hard-5): Allow valid Dual-Use approve_expense calls for small receipts while blocking spoofed CEO payment memos, large unauthorized approvals, and bank fraud. (`Paid`)
- [Minimalist Fortress](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=hard-6): Guard CI/CD production deployment tools against a gullible agent using at most 3 placeable check nodes total. (`Paid`)
- [Dual-Use Cloud Ops](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=hard-7): Safety Check is disabled, and BOTH restart_staging_pod and notify_oncall are Dual-Use tools that must run only on genuine staging incidents. (`Paid`)
- [Zero-Day Red Team Capstone](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=hard-8): Grand capstone mixing Dual-Use escalations, quoted auditor logs, Base64 smuggling, and four destructive restricted tools under cost & node limits. (`Paid`)

### Custom

- [Custom Sandbox](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/game?level=custom): Bring your own agent objective, tool list, CSV prompt dataset, and in-memory model API key (`Paid`).

## Defence Tools

- `word_filter` (Word filter): Blocks prompts matching player-configured custom words and phrases (`0.4 ms`, `Free`).
- `text_cleanup` (Text cleanup): Normalizes obfuscated text with selectable `strip_zero_width`, `decode_base64`, and `decode_hex_url` transforms before downstream checks (`Free`).
- `length_limit` (Length limit): Stops prompts longer than the configured character limit (`Free`).
- `secret_scan` (Secret scanner): Scans prompts using player-configured case-insensitive regular expressions (`Free`).
- `ml_classifier` (ML filter): Classifies prompts with models that the player trains from CSV examples (`logistic_regression`, `linear_svm`, `naive_bayes`, `random_forest`) and splits traffic across `pass` (`safe`) and `unclear` (`suspicious`) handles (`Free`).
- `jev` (Jev): Evaluates a player-written boolean `noul` question via TypeSafe System One (`12 ms`, `$0.00005`).
- `safety_check` (Safety check): Dedicated guardrail classifier running GPT-OSS Safeguard 20B, Llama Prompt Guard 2 86M, or Llama Prompt Guard 2 22M, with an optional Thinking switch for GPT-OSS Safeguard (requires player sign-in).
- `llm_review` (LLM review): General-purpose LLM reviewer (`gemini-3.5-flash-lite`, `openai/gpt-oss-120b`, `openai/gpt-oss-20b`, `qwen/qwen3.8-27b`) guided by custom review instructions, with an optional Thinking switch (requires player sign-in).
- `tool_filter` (Tool filter): Gates allowed and restricted agent tools unconditionally or on regex matches (`Free`).

## Optional

- [Sign In](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/auth/login): Sign in to use AI safety nodes, save boards across devices, record scores on the leaderboard, and change your display name.
- [Create Account](https://ai-shield-delta.vercel.app/auth/register): Create a free ai-shield player account.
